recipes.name: Mississippi Queen inspired by Regular Show
instructions: Into a blender add tomato juice, splash each of chili sauce, rice vinegar, clam juice, soy sauce, and fish sauce along with a few pieces of kimchi. - 32 oz tomato juice - Chili sauce - Rice vinegar - Clam juice - Soy Sauce - Fish Sauce - Kimchi
Peel and grate horseradish into the blender along with a little wasabi. - ¼ cup horseradish peeled and grated - Wasabi
Add in one seeded and chopped habanero pepper. Make sure to wear gloves. - 1 habanero pepper seeded and chopped.
Add in a little shake of celery salt, kosher salt, and freshly ground black pepper. Blitz in the blender until relatively smooth. - Celery salt - Kosher salt - Black Pepper

In a spice grinder, grind a few pieces of porcini mushrooms into a fine powder (do not breathe the powder dust) and pass it through a fine-mesh sieve to catch any thick chunks. Pour into the blender and blend into the bloody mary mixture. - Porcini mushrooms dried and grinded
Start by peeling and devein the shrimp by making a shallow cut down the back of the shrimp and removing the digestive tract. - Shrimp peeled and deveined

Simply sear scallops in a high smoke point oil like grapeseed oil. Sear over medium heat for a solid minute and a half before flipping onto the other side. Butter based, like a steak, for 3 minutes or until the thickest point registers at 130°F. Place on a paper towel to cool. - Scallops - Butter
Sauté each shrimp very quickly on each side and flip occasionally so the shrimp doesn’t burn. Cook until internal temperature reaches 130°F. - Shrimp peeled and deveined

In separate small bowls, dump in mayonnaise and combine Aleppo pepper with freshly grated chocolate, whisk together. Take the desired drinking glass and dip into the mayonnaise and then into the Aleppo pepper and chocolate mixture. - Mayonnaise - Aleppo pepper - Chocolate grated
To the glass, add in a few pieces of ice along with a shot of vodka and pour the bloody mary mix over top. Stir to combine. - For the Bloody Mary - Vodka
Garnish with a stalk of celery and skewered shrimp and scallops (2 of each) before enjoying with a metal straw. - For the Shrimp & Scallop - Celery
